description: This file is a JavaScript module that provides a simple API client for a React frontend application. It includes functions to determine the API base URL from environment variables and to perform authenticated GET requests with JSON processing and error handling.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Determines the API base URL from environment variables, prioritizing REACT_APP_API_BASE, then REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, and defaults to an empty string if neither is set. Normalizes the URL by removing a trailing slash.

methods.name: apiGet(path, options = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified API endpoint, handling JSON response parsing, error cases, and optional headers. Constructs the URL based on the base API URL and provided path.

search-terms: React environment variable API base URL
